title: agentpace run
description: One coding-agent run. This file is the only definition of what a row may hold. Every string is an enum or a strict pattern, so free text has no field to land in.

harness.description: The agent harness that produced the run.

effort.description: Reasoning effort the harness recorded for the run, when it recorded one.

size.description: Bucket of edit-style tool calls, measured after the run: S 1-3, M 4-10, L 11-30, XL 31+, na none.

duration_s.description: Wall clock in seconds with idle gaps clipped.

tokens.description: Deduplicated input plus output tokens, excluding cache reads.

retries.description: Count of errored tool results. A proxy: a true retry cannot be seen without reading content.

parallel_agents.description: Peak sibling agents overlapping this run, including itself.

contributor.description: Keyed hash under a random local secret. No identity goes in.

week.description: ISO week of the run start, in UTC.

batch.description: Keyed hash of the session id.

project.description: Optional keyed hash of the local project folder name.

offset_s.description: Run start on the session's own clock, measured from its first run with idle gaps clipped. Carries no clock time.
